items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: And that's why it's called local 174 496 496 496 was the black local here in New Orleans. Now it's all under the same office and everything with Dave Winstein, the president.

ctx.x: Yeah. But, uh, did you make any movies when you were with Sharky, that you remember?
No, but I did with Tony Amarica. Mm-hmm. Some street thing that they, they did, you know. Dave Winstein, Ellis Stratakis, Nick LaRocca, that's Jimmy's daddy.
